title: Livelsberger email gives Area 51 coordinates for gravitic propulsion center

tellings.quote: this very weird email sent by Matthew displays the coordinates of America gravitic propulsions Operation Center the coordinates are at Area 51

plain: A strange email that Michels attributes to a man named Matthew Livelsberger gives map coordinates for what it calls America's "gravitic propulsion" operations center, meaning craft moved by controlling gravity, and the coordinates point to Area 51, a secret military test site in Nevada. Michels brings up the 2025 email himself, without saying where he got it. He raises it as a hint that such technology exists and is kept at that base.
